questions.q: How much maternity leave is an employee entitled to, whatever her length of service?
questions.es:
26 semanas de baja por maternidad más 16 opcionales sin sueldo, sin importar la antigüedad. La prestación del Estado exige cotizaciones (PRSI).
📍 Libro M3 p.8
questions.en:
26 weeks of maternity leave plus 16 optional unpaid weeks, regardless of length of service. The State benefit requires PRSI contributions.
📍 Book M3 p.8

questions.q: A driver drove 52 hours last week. What is the most he may drive this week?
questions.es:
Máximo 90 h en dos semanas seguidas: 90 − 52 = 38 h, aunque el límite de una sola semana sea 56.
📍 Libro M11 p.2-3
questions.en:
A maximum of 90 h in two consecutive weeks: 90 − 52 = 38 h, even though the limit for a single week is 56.
📍 Book M11 p.2-3

questions.q: A vehicle costs €100,000, including tyres worth €4,000. Using 20% reducing balance, what is the depreciation in year 2?
questions.es:
Base sin neumáticos: 96.000. Año 1: 20 % = 19.200 (quedan 76.800). Año 2: 20 % de 76.800 = €15.360. El porcentaje se aplica a lo que queda.
📍 Libro M14 p.4
questions.en:
Base without tyres: 96,000. Year 1: 20% = 19,200 (76,800 left). Year 2: 20% of 76,800 = €15,360. The percentage is applied to what is left.
📍 Book M14 p.4

questions.q: An HSA inspector finds a risk of serious personal injury in a workshop. Which notice stops the activity?
questions.es:
Si hay riesgo de lesión grave, Prohibition Notice: la actividad se para hasta que se arregle. La Improvement Notice da un plazo para corregir algo que no cumple.
📍 Libro M4 p.11
questions.en:
If there is a risk of serious injury, a Prohibition Notice: the activity stops until it is fixed. An Improvement Notice gives a deadline to correct something that does not comply.
📍 Book M4 p.11

questions.q: A company makes a trading profit of €80,000 and also earns €10,000 in rent. How much corporation tax is due?
questions.es:
12,5 % de 80.000 = €10.000 (actividad) + 25 % de 10.000 = €2.500 (renta que no es de la actividad) = €12.500.
📍 Libro M9 p.1

questions.q: An external transport manager already manages 3 companies with 40 vehicles in total. Can he take on a 4th company with 15 vehicles?
options: Yes: up to 4 companies is allowed
No: the total would pass 50 vehicles
questions.es:
Gestor contratado: como máximo 4 empresas y 50 vehículos en total. 40 + 15 = 55 supera el límite.
📍 Libro M10 p.10
questions.en:
Contracted transport manager: a maximum of 4 companies and 50 vehicles in total. 40 + 15 = 55 is over the limit.
📍 Book M10 p.10

questions.q: In what time does a digital tachograph record activities?
questions.es:
El tacógrafo graba siempre en UTC (hora de Greenwich); en verano Irlanda va una hora por delante.
📍 Libro M12 p.5
questions.en:
The tachograph always records in UTC (Greenwich time); in summer Ireland is one hour ahead.
📍 Book M12 p.5

questions.q: An employee with 7 complete years' service earns €700 a week. What is the statutory redundancy payment?
questions.es:
Semanas = (2 × 7) + 1 = 15. El sueldo tiene tope de €600: 15 × 600 = €9.000. (10.500 olvida el tope.)
📍 Libro M3 p.13
questions.en:
Weeks = (2 × 7) + 1 = 15. Pay is capped at €600: 15 × 600 = €9,000. (10,500 forgets the cap.)
📍 Book M3 p.13

questions.q: How long must maintenance and inspection records be kept?
questions.es:
Los registros de mantenimiento (inspecciones, defectos y reparaciones) se guardan 15 meses.
📍 Libro M13 p.5
questions.en:
Maintenance records (inspections, defects and repairs) are kept for 15 months.
📍 Book M13 p.5

questions.q: The CIM defines marketing as the management process that identifies, anticipates and satisfies customer requirements…
questions.es:
La definición del Chartered Institute of Marketing termina en 'profitably': una empresa comercial existe sobre todo para ganar dinero.
📍 Libro M7 p.1
questions.en:
The Chartered Institute of Marketing's definition ends in 'profitably': a commercial company exists above all to make money.
📍 Book M7 p.1

questions.q: Which licence code means the holder may not drive a minibus for hire or reward?
questions.es:
Código 101: no para alquiler ni cobro (not for hire or reward). 78: solo automático; 105: no más de 5,5 m; 111: máximo 16 plazas.
📍 Libro M21 p.3
questions.en:
Code 101: not for hire or reward. 78: automatic only; 105: no more than 5.5 m; 111: maximum 16 seats.
📍 Book M21 p.3

questions.q: In SMART objectives, what does the 'T' stand for?
questions.es:
SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant (o Realistic) y Timed, es decir, con fecha límite.
📍 Libro M8 p.4
questions.en:
SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant (or Realistic) and Timed, i.e. with a deadline.
📍 Book M8 p.4

questions.q: Current assets are €150,000 and current liabilities €95,000. What is the working capital?
questions.es:
Fondo de maniobra = activo corriente − pasivo corriente = 150.000 − 95.000 = €55.000.
📍 Libro M5 p.10
questions.en:
Working capital = current assets − current liabilities = 150,000 − 95,000 = €55,000.
📍 Book M5 p.10

questions.q: A driver splits his regular daily rest. Which split is allowed?
questions.es:
Descanso diario partido: primero al menos 3 horas y después al menos 9, 12 h en total. Al revés no vale.
📍 Libro M11 p.2-3
questions.en:
Split daily rest: first at least 3 hours and then at least 9, 12 h in total. The other way round is not valid.
📍 Book M11 p.2-3

questions.q: What does a Green Card prove?
questions.es:
La Carta Verde es la prueba internacional del seguro del vehículo.
📍 Libro M24
questions.en:
The Green Card is international proof of the vehicle's insurance.
📍 Book M24

questions.q: A depot needs 30 bus duties a day, 6 days a week, and each driver works 5 days. How many drivers are needed before holiday cover?
questions.es:
Turnos de la semana = 30 × 6 = 180 ÷ 5 días = 36 conductores, más los de vacaciones.
📍 Libro M30 p.8
questions.en:
Duties in the week = 30 × 6 = 180 ÷ 5 days = 36 drivers, plus holiday cover.
📍 Book M30 p.8

questions.q: What is the minimum issued share capital of a public limited company (PLC)?
questions.es:
Una PLC necesita un capital nominal y emitido de al menos €25.000; la sociedad limitada privada (Ltd) no tiene mínimo.
📍 Libro M2 p.6
questions.en:
A PLC needs nominal and issued share capital of at least €25,000; a private limited company (Ltd) has no minimum.
📍 Book M2 p.6

questions.q: Within how long must a driver return used analogue charts to the employer?
questions.es:
Los discos usados se devuelven a la empresa en un plazo de 42 días, y se guardan 12 meses (2 años si sirven para el tiempo de trabajo).
📍 Libro M12 p.10
questions.en:
Used charts are returned to the company within 42 days, and kept for 12 months (2 years if used for working time).
📍 Book M12 p.10

questions.q: Diesel costs €1.44 a litre (excluding VAT) and the vehicle does 3.6 km per litre. What is the fuel cost per km?
questions.es:
Combustible por km = precio del litro ÷ km por litro = 1,44 ÷ 3,6 = €0,40. Multiplicar (5,18) es el error típico.
📍 Libro M14 p.8
questions.en:
Fuel per km = price per litre ÷ km per litre = 1.44 ÷ 3.6 = €0.40. Multiplying (5.18) is the typical mistake.
📍 Book M14 p.8

questions.q: What does 'plating' a vehicle certify?
questions.es:
El 'plating' certifica los pesos máximos (GVW, GTW y por eje). Superarlos es delito.
📍 Libro M19 p.1
questions.en:
Plating certifies the maximum weights (GVW, GTW and per axle). Exceeding them is an offence.
📍 Book M19 p.1

questions.q: On ferry crossings of more than 20 miles from an EU port, what must the coach operator give the shipping line?
questions.es:
Convenio SOLAS / Directiva 98/41: apellido, nombre, sexo, edad y necesidades especiales de cada pasajero, en trayectos de más de 20 millas.
📍 Libro M26 p.5-7
questions.en:
SOLAS Convention / Directive 98/41: surname, first name, sex, age and special needs of each passenger, on crossings of more than 20 miles.
📍 Book M26 p.5-7

questions.q: Two competing operators agree by phone that both will submit high bids for a public tender so that one of them wins. This is:
questions.es:
Es manipular la licitación (bid-rigging), un cártel prohibido por la sección 4 de la Competition Act, aunque el acuerdo sea de palabra.
📍 Libro M29
questions.en:
It is bid-rigging, a cartel prohibited by section 4 of the Competition Act, even if the agreement is verbal.
📍 Book M29

questions.q: Under general working time law, after how long must an employee get a 15-minute break?
questions.es:
Ley general: 15 minutos a partir de 4 h 30 de trabajo y 30 minutos a partir de 6 horas.
📍 Libro M3 p.18
questions.en:
General law: 15 minutes after 4 h 30 of work and 30 minutes after 6 hours.
📍 Book M3 p.18

questions.q: Who may stop a moving vehicle on the road for a roadside check?
questions.es:
Solo la Garda puede parar un vehículo en marcha; después lo revisan la Garda y los inspectores de la RSA.
📍 Libro M20 p.5
questions.en:
Only the Garda can stop a moving vehicle; then the Garda and RSA inspectors check it.
📍 Book M20 p.5

questions.q: Under Regulation 1370/2007, a public bus contract may be awarded directly (de minimis) when its average annual value is below:
questions.es:
De minimis: menos de €1 millón al año de media o menos de 300.000 km al año (para pymes con 23 vehículos o menos, €2 millones o 600.000 km).
📍 Libro M31
questions.en:
De minimis: an average of less than €1 million a year or less than 300,000 km a year (for SMEs with 23 vehicles or fewer, €2 million or 600,000 km).
📍 Book M31

questions.q: What is the vehicle's internal network that links the engine, brake and gearbox control units called?
questions.es:
El CANbus une las centralitas del motor, los frenos y la caja de cambios; de ahí saca los datos la telemática.
📍 Libro M17 p.1
questions.en:
The CANbus connects the engine, brake and gearbox control units; that is where telematics gets its data.
📍 Book M17 p.1

questions.q: Which of these does NOT need a passenger operator licence?
options: A hotel carrying its guests for free
A firm hiring out coaches with drivers
A company running a paid shuttle
questions.es:
Si no se cobra por llevar a los pasajeros no hace falta licencia de operador; el libro pone justo el ejemplo del hotel con transporte gratuito.
📍 Libro M10 p.4
questions.en:
If no charge is made for carrying the passengers, no operator licence is needed; the book gives exactly the example of a hotel with free transport.
📍 Book M10 p.4

questions.q: Goods are sent 'carriage forward'. Who pays the carriage?
questions.es:
'Carriage forward': paga el porte quien recibe (consignee). 'Carriage paid': paga quien envía (consignor).
📍 Libro M6 p.2
questions.en:
'Carriage forward': the receiver (consignee) pays the carriage. 'Carriage paid': the sender (consignor) pays.
📍 Book M6 p.2

questions.q: Under the 12-day rule for international coach tours, a single driver who drives between 22:00 and 06:00 must:
questions.es:
Con la regla de los 12 días, de noche hace falta doble tripulación o, con un solo conductor, pausa cada 3 horas en lugar de cada 4 h 30.
📍 Libro M11 p.4
questions.en:
Under the 12-day rule, at night you need multi-manning or, with a single driver, a break every 3 hours instead of every 4 h 30.
📍 Book M11 p.4

questions.q: Which of these is a duty of EMPLOYEES under the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005?
questions.es:
Los empleados deben cuidar su seguridad y la de los demás, usar los equipos de protección, no trabajar bajo el efecto del alcohol o las drogas, avisar de peligros y defectos y asistir a la formación. La declaración de seguridad y la evaluación de riesgos son cosa del empresario.
📍 Libro M4
questions.en:
Employees must take care of their own safety and that of others, use protective equipment, not work under the influence of alcohol or drugs, report hazards and defects and attend training. The safety statement and the risk assessment are the employer's job.
📍 Book M4

questions.q: What does a double continuous yellow line along the kerb mean?
options: No parking during the hours shown
questions.es:
Doble línea continua: prohibido aparcar las 24 horas. Línea simple: prohibido durante el horario que indique la señal.
📍 Libro M22 p.3
questions.en:
Double continuous line: no parking 24 hours a day. Single line: no parking during the hours shown on the sign.
📍 Book M22 p.3

questions.q: A coach hire costs €1,800 and the organiser expects to sell 45 tickets on a 53-seat coach. What should each ticket cost to cover the hire?
questions.es:
Precio por pasajero = precio total ÷ billetes que se espera vender = 1.800 ÷ 45 = €40. Dividir entre las 53 plazas solo vale si el autocar va lleno.
📍 Libro M14 p.15
questions.en:
Price per passenger = total price ÷ tickets expected to be sold = 1,800 ÷ 45 = €40. Dividing by the 53 seats only works if the coach is full.
📍 Book M14 p.15

questions.q: Net profit before tax is €45,000 and capital employed is €300,000. What is the return on capital employed (ROCE)?
questions.es:
ROCE = beneficio neto antes de impuestos × 100 ÷ capital empleado = 45.000 × 100 ÷ 300.000 = 15 %.
📍 Libro M5 p.10
questions.en:
ROCE = net profit before tax × 100 ÷ capital employed = 45,000 × 100 ÷ 300,000 = 15%.
📍 Book M5 p.10

questions.q: From what age must a professional driver renewing a C or D licence provide a medical report?
questions.es:
Desde los 45 años no basta la autodeclaración: hace falta revisión médica con el formulario D4; desde los 65, la renovación es cada año.
📍 Libro M21 p.6
questions.en:
From age 45 a self-declaration is not enough: a medical check with form D4 is needed; from 65, renewal is every year.
📍 Book M21 p.6

questions.q: A coach trip lasts two days and includes a hotel night, sold at one inclusive price. Under package travel law it is:
questions.es:
Hay 'package' si se combinan al menos 2 elementos (transporte, alojamiento u otro servicio turístico importante) a precio global, por más de 24 h o con una noche.
📍 Libro M30 p.10
questions.en:
It is a 'package' if at least 2 elements are combined (transport, accommodation or another significant tourist service) at an inclusive price, for more than 24 h or including a night.
📍 Book M30 p.10

questions.q: A driver using analogue charts changes vehicle during the day. What must he do?
options: Note its registration, time and km on the chart
Nothing: just start a fresh chart for it
Note only the new vehicle's registration
Note the new vehicle's fuel and oil level
questions.es:
Se apuntan los datos del segundo vehículo (matrícula, hora del cambio y lectura del cuentakilómetros) en el disco que ya lleva.
📍 Libro M12
questions.en:
The details of the second vehicle (registration, time of the change and odometer reading) are written on the chart already in use.
📍 Book M12

questions.q: By what date must a self-employed operator file and pay income tax each year (pay and file)?
questions.es:
Los autónomos hacen la declaración y pagan cada año antes del 31 de octubre (pay and file), con PRSI de clase S.
📍 Libro M9
questions.en:
The self-employed file their return and pay every year by 31 October (pay and file), with Class S PRSI.
📍 Book M9

questions.q: Who should carry out vehicle safety inspections?
questions.es:
Las hace personal técnicamente competente, propio o de un taller contratado; no se le debe pedir que repare mientras inspecciona.
📍 Libro M13 p.5
questions.en:
They are carried out by technically competent staff, in-house or from a contracted workshop; they should not be asked to repair while inspecting.
📍 Book M13 p.5

questions.q: Why are there passport checks on journeys between Ireland and France?
options: France is not in the EU
questions.es:
Irlanda no está en Schengen (por la Zona Común de Viaje con el Reino Unido): al salir y al volver hay control de pasaportes.
📍 Libro M32 p.4
questions.en:
Ireland is not in Schengen (because of the Common Travel Area with the UK): there are passport checks when leaving and returning.
📍 Book M32 p.4

questions.q: How long do the other countries have to give their views on an application for an international regular coach service?
questions.es:
Los países consultados tienen 2 meses para opinar; la autoridad decide en 4 meses y, si no puede, decide la Comisión Europea en 6.
📍 Libro M10 p.19
questions.en:
The countries consulted have 2 months to give their views; the authority decides within 4 months and, if it cannot, the European Commission decides within 6.
📍 Book M10 p.19
